🌍 TerritoryWar

A territory control game: expand your domain by claiming adjacent cells or regions. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Claim cells or regions to expand your territory.
  2. Adjacent claims can connect to form larger regions.
  3. Defend your territory from AI opponents trying to take it.
  4. Balance expansion (more territory) with consolidation (stronger holdings).
  5. Control the most territory by the end to win.
